description:
Parent plan: https://chatgpt.com/space/page_0d26b92b5bc8819181fab088efc0283c

## Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add
lib/zaq/channels/jido_chat_bridge.ex. Retain trusted context, prepare once, map to FileUpload kind file, extend existing create_message/Thread.post. Files create a final post even with status ID; file-free edit remains. Final post ID is receipt/on_reply target. Translate safe adapter errors, generic fallback and uncertainty; no provider rules or retries.

## Tests to add before implementation
Existing bridge tests: binary filename/MIME/thread/caption, document semantics for images, real adapter upload->post IDs, no-file edit, file create, adapter multi-file/size rejection, generic error, upload failure vs post failure, status failure and callback failure with one upload/send.

## Branches/paths validated
Success, preparation failure, unsupported collection, provider rejection, ambiguous timeout; cosmetic update must not alter confirmed delivery. Preserve unsupported nonbinary-body handling.

## Mocking plan
Use existing adapter transport injection for focused external failures; real Mattermost reserved for consolidated E2E.

## Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content
Keep affected module docs accurate. Coordinate the final docs/services/channels.md update and update this issue with evidence/decisions; follow documentation hygiene.

## Action reuse assessment
Extend JidoChatBridge; reuse Thread.post, FileUpload and adapter operations. Adapter owns uploads/restrictions; downstream status translates returned outcome only. No new send Action or provider HTTP path.

## Constraints and validation
Read parent settled decisions and applicable repository service, tool-routing, Action reuse and testing policies before implementation. Preserve current test behavior. Follow authoritative validation lifecycle; feature E2E authoring waits for final review task, but focused tests are immediate. Agent selection and #875 acquisition budgets are outside scope. No global configuration mutation.

comments.text: Module-context and live Action reuse: JidoChatBridge owns outbound orchestration, runtime adapter resolution, status edit selection and on_reply bookkeeping. Existing send_reply strips connection details to url/token; do_send_reply chooses adapter, handle_send_with_adapter edits metadata.message_id or creates through create_message/8 -> Jido.Chat.Thread.post -> Adapter.post_message. DeliveryResult owns edit acknowledgements only and must remain unchanged. FileUpload and PostPayload are the canonical request boundary; Jido Adapter.post_message owns upload-candidate count and currently returns :multiple_attachments_unsupported for multiple files when adapter has no native post_message callback. Mattermost send_file uploads through transport.upload_file then transport.send_message with file_ids and caption/thread; returned Response.external_message_id is final post ID, upload IDs only metadata. Telegram FileUpload kind file selects sendDocument even for image MIME. Neither adapter contains local byte thresholds; actual transport HTTP rejection is returned. Transport is a supported per-call dependency; no new global config mutations or fake production callback needed. Existing DownloadDocument/Materialization discovery from .2 remains valid, reused by DeliveryFiles only; provider transport/upload functionality reused via Thread.post/FileUpload/real adapters. Decision extend existing bridge; no new Action, provider HTTP, limits catalog, retries, dedupe, sequential file sends or tool exposure. State ownership: prepared bytes call-local, source owns original files, provider owns uploads/posts, Oban owns callback jobs, existing config owns adapter registry. Flow: envelope trusted context -> DeliveryFiles.with_prepared once -> file uploads kind file -> existing Thread.post -> adapter upload/post -> receipt actual post ID -> protected callback/status bookkeeping. File-free behavior remains existing edit/create flow; nonbinary unsupported body handling preserved. Errors returned through existing bridge contract; safe status text translates actual adapter count rejection or HTTP413 without numeric thresholds or raw provider bodies; timeout means unconfirmed. Status/callback errors, exceptions and exits cannot turn confirmed send into failure/retry. Test gaps to fill before code: exact bytes/name/MIME/thread/caption, image document semantics, final post vs upload/status ID, adapter count/size/errors, preparation denial, upload/post failure, timeout ambiguity, missing final ID and once-only effects after status/callback exceptions/exits. Existing bridge tests prove file-free edit/create/format/on_reply paths; existing Jido delivery HTTP tests exercise real adapters. New tests will use existing adapter transport opt and no new global config mutation; existing fixtures/scenarios unchanged. Serena new worktree activation succeeded, symbol overview returned empty, bounded fallback used.

Tests-first red evidence: existing Jido/Telegram delivery group 16/26 passed, 10 new file scenarios failed before production. After wiring, group passed 26 (1 property, 25 tests). Exact adapter timeout shapes tested: bare :timeout and actual Req.TransportError reason :timeout. Callback test uses real Oban worker args and confirms final-post-id (not upload-id or status-id). Status errors/raises/exits and callback exits preserve confirmation with one upload/post. First q identified only create arity9; consolidated existing connection params into create opts (arity7), no new public API, q then passed. Self-review found a structured body could carry extra unprepared attachment fields when files were present; new file path now accepts only binary captions, rejecting nonbinary body before upload, while file-free existing body handling remains unchanged. Focused negative case added. Safe status examples: Files sent.; These files could not be sent together. The provider does not support multiple attachments.; The provider rejected the files as too large.; Files could not be sent.; File delivery could not be confirmed. Check the conversation before sending again. No arbitrary provider body interpolated. Adapter/core owns current multiple-file rejection; passed whole collection without ZAQ count validation, omission or sequential sends. Existing transport retry behavior retained unchanged. No new global config mutation, existing test fixtures/assertions untouched. Final relevant regression group and q next.
